test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2000 as a sum borrowed at 7% per year rate of interest for 3 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2000

Rate of interest (R) = 7% per year

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (2000 × 7 × 3) / 100

⇒ SI = (42000) / 100

⇒ SI = ₹420

**The simple interest on ₹2000 at 7% per year for 3 years is ₹420.**
